title: AUTH-080 Logout clears local access after delay

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And access A is expired; refresh R expires at controlled time T+600 seconds
4. And the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is visible
5. When User A clicks the button labelled "Logout" inside the dialog named "Your session has been expired"
6. And the controlled browser clock advances through the 1000-millisecond logout delay
7. Then the textbox with placeholder "Enter Username" on the login page is visible
8. And the text input with placeholder "Enter Password" on the login page is visible
9. And the button labelled "Sign In" on the login page is visible
10. And the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is absent
11. And the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is absent
12. And localStorage and sessionStorage contain no access credential

annotations.description: Actual MFE; Playwright clock; controlled API responses; unsigned browser-only credentials. No natural lifecycle or BFF expiry claim.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
